Appreciate the heads up. Quick update: our travel team had to reroute Tom's flight due to an equipment delay. He now lands later on 5/20 and has a mandatory hospital leadership check-in that afternoon. We still want the product walkthrough but two asks:

1) Can you compress the onsite portion to 30 minutes (core demo + Q&A) earlier in the morning?
2) If 30 minutes isn't feasible onsite, can we move the full demo to Friday 5/21 as a virtual session?

Tom, Dr. Hayes (cc'd), and I can make the following windows: 5/20 08:30–09:15, 5/20 09:30–10:00, or 5/21 11:00–12:30 PT.

- Option B: Move full 60–75 minute demo to 5/21 virtual (11:00–12:30).

Marcus — you'll be onsite; can you do a tight 30-minute run-through if we compress? Karthik — if we compress, can you handle the follow-up office hours next day (virtual) to cover integrations and pricing?
